External lexical verification: 269 of 269 bank rows have retrieved contextual-sense evidence; 0 remain editorial-only and are explicitly listed. All six originally partial rows now have targeted closure receipts; Arabic and French glosses were narrowed/qualified for clarity where the actual receipts exposed an ambiguity. General morphology/register sources are never counted as lexical receipts by themselves.

All seven French idioms now have actual definition/meaning receipts. The final ce n’est pas la mer à boire gap was closed against Académie MER and Larousse collège mer sense 7; earlier failed accesses remain recorded.

French literature context is partly verified: Les Misérables redemption/rebellion summary, Madame Bovary broad realist classification, L’Étranger 1942 French date, and Le Rouge et le Noir ambition/social theme are retained editorial knowledge rather than newly retrieved claim-specific receipts. BnF Rouge publication excerpt was search-readable only; direct fetch failed.

Russian term-specific sources exist for eight English device records, not for all three subjects. French-language primary material remains FR provenance; Arabic teaching references used here explain Arabic in EN.
